chunks: Then they will indeed burn in Hell.

key_terms.الْجَحِيمِ: Hellfire (specifically a deep part of Hell)

ai.seo_question: What is the fate of the defrauded according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who cheat in transactions, linking their specific sin to the intense heat of Al-Jahim. It serves as a potent eschatological warning, emphasizing that unjust gain leads not merely to punishment but to a permanent dwelling in the lower levels of Hell.
